src/router/trie-router/node.ts:203 — slash count used non-global `match`, always returning at most one component. Changed to `match(/\//g)` so queued traversal advances across all captured path segments.

Fix removes duplicate wildcard handler execution and restores matching for arbitrary multi-part captures.

Verified: 75 TrieRouter tests pass; direct Hono middleware repro returns `200` with `runs === 1`. Full test command remains blocked by unrelated existing TypeScript errors outside the router.
